scope: Existing actual native USB/SD/I2S/EPD outer-layer LINEs checked against actual adjacent CAM GND; this is not completion of absent/unrouted nets or signal-integrity qualification.

screening_parameters.ribbon_and_centerline_geometry: Actual CAM copper inside each native LINE envelope, excluding actual drills. Native LINE remainder must be covered by actual CAM within format-roundtrip tolerance; actual adjacent GND is never expanded.
screening_parameters.classification_note: 1mm local-window and2mm existing via-return screens are project geometric review thresholds, not electromagnetic or industry-standard pass limits. A connected local GND window does not measure current density, detour path length, impedance or timing.

limitations: No fabricated continuity, copper/plating thickness, impedance, crosstalk, return-current field, EMI, edge-rate or timing qualification.
Existing routed copper only. Missing nets, terminal connectivity, SCH/PCB equivalence, full CAM topology/shorts and native DRC must pass separately.
A source GND label plus matched actual barrel contact identifies local reference copper; full-board CAM GND-single-group verification remains independently required.
Every missing centerline interval is retained. Small CAM-quantization-scale cases are explicitly flagged, never joined or silently discarded.
A void chain may be long even when the crossed gap is short: connected void extent and actual local GND bypass are both reported.
